meta.calibration_note: Ad-level inputs (spend, installs, placements, SSOT trial starts and LTV, AppsFlyer plan mix) are October only. A week of cohorts is too few to calibrate the market constants on, so trial-to-paid, LTV per paid user and K (LTV per install) are estimated on 1 Jun – 7 Oct 2026; the plan-mix prior uses October AppsFlyer trials.
